prompt:
An original road rock song, 120 bpm, 4/4, key of E. Warm 1970s analog sound, gritty electric guitar riff, bass, live drums, confident female lead vocal, group backing vocals in the chorus. Structure: [Intro, 12 seconds] a single clean palm-muted guitar riff with a soft hi-hat, no vocals. [Verse, 16 seconds] the vocal enters over guitar, bass and light drums. [Drum fill] one loud two-beat tom and snare fill. [Chorus, 24 seconds] full band, loud and anthemic, a singalong. [Outro] the riff once more and one big final ringing chord with a cymbal crash, clean ending.

Lyrics:
[Verse]
Left the coop with the lights turned low,
a borrowed car and a radio.
Every sign says eat in, take away,
not this chick, not today.

[Chorus]
Kudakh, kudakh, the road is long,
the fryer's hot, but I am gone.
No bun, no pita, no lavash,
to co-co-cosmos, I'll be kudakh!
Kudakh, kudakh, the road is long,
to co-co-cosmos, I'll be kudakh!
